title: CPSC, Full Speed Ahead Announce Recall of Scatto Bicycle Wheel Quick Releases Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: An internal part in the lever mechanism can break, reducing clamping effectiveness and rendering the unit inoperable, potentially causing a bicyclist to fall. Units: About 1,375 sets.

title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The handlebar may loosen and turn unexpectedly, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, PlayKids USA Announce Recall of Baby Walkers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed if they fall down stairs. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of TV/VCR Carts Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The carts can tip over and the television can fall off, posing a risk of serious injury or death if the TV and cart fall on a child. Units: 300,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The throttle cable may bind when the handlebars are turned full left or full right, resulting in an increase in engine speed and unintended vehicle acceleration. In addition, the fuel line may rub against the vehicle chassis, resulting in a fuel line leak, which could be a fire hazard. Units: About

title: CPSC, IKEA Home Furnishings Announce Recall of Glass-Door Wall Cabinets Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: Some of these glass-door wall cabinets have the wrong sized screws for the safety bracket, which can result in the cabinet not being properly secured to the wall. The cabinets can fall and injure nearby consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: CPSC, Natura Products Downey Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests, come apart, and can pose a choking hazard to infants and small children. Units: About 9,400.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Director's Chairs for Children Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
summary: The chair can inadvertently be misassembled, so that the fabric seat can come off the chair's frame and expose metal support rods. If fabric seat comes off the frame, there is a laceration and fall hazard to young children. Units: About 81,000.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc., and Deere & Company Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: Front brake hose can be pulled out of its retaining brackets on either side of the ATV by foreign objects. This can cause the brake hose to wear by rubbing on the inner wheel or shock absorber spring seat, ultimately causing a brake fluid leak, resulting in a complete loss of front braking capacity.

title: CPSC, Eddie Bauer Announce Recall of Ebtek Brand Backpacks with Stools
summary: The stool could collapse and cause the person using the stool to fall. The stool does not meet the firm's strength requirements. Units: About 300 units.

title: CPSC, Performance Inc. and Supergo Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebars
summary: The handlebars can develop cracks that may not be visible, which can cause the handlebar to break without warning, resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC, Gruga U.S.A. Announce Recall to Repair Office Chairs Sold At Staples Stores
summary: The legs on the base of the chair can break, posing a risk of injury to the user. Units: 18,000.

title: CPSC, Wild Country Ltd. Announce Recall of Helium Carabiners
summary: The carabiner gate may come open under a heavy load, which will significantly reduce the strength of the carabiner. The carabiner could break if the climber falls, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the climber. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Reebok International Announce Recall of Toddler's Athletic Shoes
summary: The I-3 logo-tag on the tongue of the shoe can be peeled off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 140,000.
